# Municipal Ordinance No. 05, Series of 2023 — Amending Cockpit Franchise of Mrs. Rosita L. Batralo

## Summary

This ordinance amends [[MO-02-S2020]], which originally granted a cockpit arena franchise to [[Mrs. Rosita L. Batralo]] for the operation and maintenance of a cockpit arena in the [[Municipality of Pitogo]]. The [[Sangguniang Bayan ng Pitogo]] is empowered under [[RA 7160]] Rule I Article 3(d) and Rule XVII Article 100(3)(v) to license and regulate cockfighting activity. The ordinance notes the local tourism benefits of cockfighting events in the municipality.

## Key Provisions

- Amends the cockpit franchise previously granted to [[Mrs. Rosita L. Batralo]] under [[MO-02-S2020]].
- Cites RA 7160 Rule I Article 3(d) and Rule XVII Article 100(3)(v) as the legal basis for licensing and regulating cockfighting.
- Recognizes the contribution of cockfighting activities to local tourism and economic development.
- Retains the Sangguniang Bayan's regulatory authority over cockpit arena operations.

## Legal Basis

- [[Sec-447-RA7160]] — Powers, duties, and functions of the Sangguniang Bayan.
- Section 447(a)(3)(v) of [[RA 7160]] — Specific power to authorize, license, and regulate cockfighting activity and cockpit operations.
- RA 7160 Implementing Rules and Regulations, Rule I Article 3(d) and Rule XVII Article 100(3)(v).

## Related DILG Legal Opinions

- [[LO-0124-S2024]] — Whether a Municipal Mayor can issue a special permit for cockfighting during a local fiesta.
- [[LO-0129-S2024]] — Whether the law should be interpreted to mean a singular cockpit for the entire city.
